item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-9b6e75695f53a9f8","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A national SDGs communications strategy and action plan was developed through consultations involving more than 2,000 participants, targeting marginalized communities and emphasizing inclusivity, citizen empowerment, human development, governance, transparency, and accountability; the UN described it as fulfilling a September 2023 pledge by Sheikh Hasina.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","6B.1","6B.3","6B.5","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The source is dated 2024 and describes a strategy for 2024-2030, but attributes its pledge and planning basis to September 2023; it is not direct evidence of 2023 implementation outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The UN source attributes the pledge to Sheikh Hasina and describes government planning under her administration.","limitations":["The strategy is future-oriented and does not establish completed 2023 outcomes.","Positive statements include official and UN characterizations rather than an independent evaluation of implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-78472c85937395ae","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"An ADB sector assessment published in March 2023 identified agriculture as generating over 40 percent of jobs, noted harms from the pandemic and food-price rises, and described an approach centered on food security, value chains, commercialization, rural connectivity, natural-resource management, poverty reduction, and resilient rural development.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in March 2023 and directly relevant to conditions and policy priorities during 2023, but it assesses the sector and ADB strategy rather than Sheikh Hasina’s individual decisions or completed results.","ruler_attribution":"The source does not directly attribute the described strategy or outcomes to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["No specific attribution to the ruler’s formal decisions, budgets, appointments, or enforcement.","The assessment describes needs and strategy, not verified policy execution or distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-463b60ae60963ea5,","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"An IRI account of the 2026 election retrospectively characterized the preceding period as following more than 15 years of Awami League rule and described that rule as authoritarian; this is contextual evidence about the broader period, not a 2023-specific event.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.8","4B.9","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The source concerns the 2026 election and July 2024 transition, so its characterization of the Hasina period is retrospective and weakly time-specific for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source explicitly associates the more-than-15-year Awami League rule with the period ending after the July 2024 uprising; it does not detail individual 2023 decisions.","limitations":["No direct 2023 evidence is provided.","The characterization is an IRI delegation statement in a later election report, not a contemporaneous 2023 investigation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bc9bb80ecc1aa330","start_unit":14,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that an inquiry was established into enforced disappearances during Sheikh Hasina’s 15-year rule; it cited an estimate of 708 disappearances, nearly 100 people still missing, alleged clandestine detention sites, torture, official denials, and harassment or reprisals against relatives. It also reported that the previous government had refused for years to recognize enforced disappearances or sign the relevant international convention.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in August 2024 and covering the preceding 15 years, including 2023; it is retrospective and does not isolate the number or dates of 2023 cases.","ruler_attribution":"The report directly identifies the disappearances and government refusals as occurring during Sheikh Hasina’s rule, while reporting allegations and estimates from Odhikar and victims.","limitations":["The 708 figure is an NGO estimate cited by HRW, not a final judicial finding.","The report was published after Hasina’s resignation and relies partly on retrospective testimony and investigation claims.","It does not establish personal orders by Hasina in individual cases."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb2bf13ce416bdf3","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International and five civil-society organizations expressed alarm in May 2023 at concerns.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published 3 May 2023 and directly concerns conditions during the target protesters and police that left at least two people dead, raids on opposition officials’ residences, arrest of BNP secretary-general Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, and prior verified evidence of excessive force and violent attacks against protesters and opposition leaders. Amnesty called for independent investigations, lawful use of force, and protection of peaceful assembly before the January election.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published 30 October 2023 and directly concerns the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes conduct to Bangladeshi authorities and law-enforcement agencies during Sheikh Hasina’s premiership, but does not prove a personal order by Hasina.","limitations":["Some details are attributed to media reports and BNP claims; Amnesty separately states it verified prior evidence of excessive force.","The extract does not report the results of investigations or any remedy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-67c67d7b05133a79","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A 2026 opinion article credited Sheikh Hasina’s 15-year rule with sustained development initiatives, infrastructure, rural electrification, digital networks, expanded social safety nets, women’s empowerment, microfinance, rural development, education, and maternal healthcare, while acknowledging criticism concerning democratic governance and political pluralism.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","6B.10","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The article is dated 2026 and retrospectively covers 15 years, including 2023; it does not isolate 2023 decisions or outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The author directly attributes the described development and welfare initiatives to Sheikh Hasina’s governance.","limitations":["The source is explicitly an opinion article and uses strongly favorable language.","It provides no quantified evidence, independent evaluation, budget records, or causal comparison.","Its acknowledgment of democratic criticism is general and unsourced in the supplied units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b4be3e29374adbc","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In a March 2024 interview, Sheikh Hasina described a 12-year Perspective Plan, needs analysis, present/mid-term/long-term policy timelines, time-bound targets for literacy, nutrition, income, and healthcare, and a policy of reducing donor dependence by rejecting foreign-borrowed development financing; she asserted that implementation had produced successful results by 2021.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.5","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published in 2024 and describing planning and claimed results from 2009-2021; it supplies background relevant to 2023 but no direct 2023 outcome evidence.","ruler_attribution":"The statements are Sheikh Hasina’s own account of her administration’s planning and financing approach.","limitations":["Claims of successful results and reduced dependency are self-reported and not independently evaluated in the supplied extract.","The source does not provide executed budgets, appointment records, implementation metrics, or 2023-specific results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-545545b9d1f93d2f","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The UN Resident Coordinator reported that Bangladesh experienced three cyclones and major floods and landslides in 2023 affecting millions; Bangladesh had adopted a 2023-2050 National Adaptation Plan, established a Bangladesh Climate Development Program, adopted an Early Warning for All roadmap for 2023-2027, created a multi-hazard anticipatory-action framework, and delivered timely cash payments to 45,000 people before Cyclone Mocha and flash floods.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","6B.10","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published April 2024 but reports 2023 disasters and government planning and preparedness measures implemented or adopted in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The speech identifies Sheikh Hasina as prime minister and calls the Climate Development Program her initiative; other measures are attributed to Bangladesh’s government.","limitations":["The source is a UN official’s speech and does not independently evaluate the ruler’s personal role or all implementation results.","It reports preparedness inputs and selected outputs, not comprehensive distributional or long-term outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-f20b678f17f855a5","SRC-b18c97a70a545c2b","SRC-da477a5bd3500ebf"],"batch_limitations":["Several sources are retrospective, post-period, opinion-based, or incomplete; they should not be treated as direct, comprehensive evidence of Sheikh Hasina’s 2023 conduct.","No supplied document provides material evidence about nuclear-risk governance, arms control, proliferation controls, or other existential-risk safeguards during 2023."]}
